verdict.rationale: Customer.io has an official MCP server that can read workspace data, list all active automations, and work with segments. It also has a CLI that gives AI agents full workspace access, an App API for fetching data, and a published OpenAPI spec. Its built-in agent claims it can analyze performance and run scheduled broadcast recaps and segment audits, which covers the reporting part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of campaign or message performance metrics being retrievable via MCP, CLI or API (only implied by 'analyze performance' and 'broadcast recaps'), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven program reporting.
